briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies AGI race as compute bottlenecks emerge

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with new model releases while regulatory scrutiny grows. Compute shortages and safety gaps dominate discussions across the ecosystem.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic countered with Claude 4.5 Opus. Google DeepMind and xAI pushed internal updates while Meta open-sourced Llama 4 weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters in Europe and Asia. TSMC reports record AI chip orders for Q3.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will compute constraints or safety incidents slow the AGI timeline before 2028?
